subtests.name: MediaStream, MediaStreamTrack and MediaStreamTrackEvent are exposed in a dedicated worker
An empty MediaStream can be constructed in a dedicated worker
A MediaStream can be constructed from transferred tracks in a dedicated worker
A MediaStream can be constructed from another MediaStream in a dedicated worker
MediaStream.getTrackById() works in a dedicated worker
MediaStream.addTrack() and removeTrack() work in a dedicated worker
MediaStream.clone() works in a dedicated worker
MediaStreamTrackEvent can be constructed in a dedicated worker
A MediaStream in a dedicated worker becomes inactive when its tracks are stopped
